facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Media's permanent secretary says the Access to Information Act came into force on 25 June 2025 after the minister signed a commencement order.
The permanent secretary says the Access to Information Regulations, 2025 (SI No. 56 of 2025) were signed on 29 August 2025.

The permanent secretary says the Access to Information Guidelines were published on 5 December 2025 through Gazette Notice No. 1624 of 2025; the Act's rules were still being finalised by the Ministry of Justice for the Chief Justice's signature in July 2026.

The document is the text of Zambia's Access to Information Act, 2023 (Act No. 24 of 2023), assented to on 22 December 2023, giving citizens and residence permit holders a right to information held by public and private bodies, with commencement on a date the Minister appoints by statutory instrument.

facts.fact: MakanDay reports Zambia's Access to Information Act, passed in December 2023 and assented to that month, came into force on 25 June 2024.
MakanDay reports requests under the Act are made on Form I, the official form prescribed under the Act's General Regulations.

MakanDay reports the Human Rights Commission, the Act's oversight body, wrote on 23 June 2026 that it had written to the Ministry of Health directing it to comply with the law on MakanDay's requests; the Ministry had still not responded.
The Human Rights Commission says the Access to Information Act, No. 24 of 2023, came into force on 25 June 2024 under Statutory Instrument No. 35 of 2024.
